annotations.rationale: Named disease in the title that refers to one specific condition (myotonic dystrophy), not a family of diseases.
Refers to a family of multiple muscular dystrophies with adult onset that can be further categorized, so it is a Disease Class.

annotations.rationale: In apposition to the adult muscular dystrophy class, this names a single specific disease with one definition.
Abbreviation in parentheses for myotonic dystrophy; the short form is annotated as a separate synonymous mention from the long form.
DM is used as a noun modifier of 'linkage study' and so is annotated as a Modifier.
DM is used as a standalone coordinated noun ('between DM and APOC2') referring to the disease itself, not as a modifier.
DM modifies the noun 'locus' in 'the DM locus', so it is annotated as a Modifier.
